Class GameController

java.lang.Object
controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, ClientCommandVisitor
public final class GameController extends Object implements Runnable, ClientCommandVisitor
Engine for a game session. Holds the command queue and the game thread: this thread is the only one that mutates the GameModel, by construction.

Dispatch

The run() method takes one ClientCommand at a time and calls cmd.accept(this). The controller implements ClientCommandVisitor to dispatch based on the command family (GameCommand → handleCommand(GameCommand), LobbyCommand → lobbyCommandVisitor, HeartbeatCommand → no-op). The four lifecycle commands of interest (LeaveCommand, PlayerDisconnectedCommand, PlayerReconnectedCommand, SuspensionTimeoutCommand) are handled by the anonymous lobbyCommandVisitor.

Suspension and disconnection resilience

When only one player remains connected the match enters a suspended state (flag suspended, inspected in visit(GameCommand)). A timer of 60L seconds is scheduled on the suspensionScheduler; the task does NOT touch the model directly but instead enqueues a SuspensionTimeoutCommand so that the end-of-game happens on the game thread like any other event. If at least one other player reconnects before the timeout the future is cancelled and the suspended flag is reset to false.

Constructors

  • GameController(List) is the production constructor: it receives the PlayerEntry objects from a full lobby, builds the GameModel, initializes the match and creates the game thread (not started). start() wires the players' command queues to the controller and starts the thread; shutdown() stops it.
  • GameController(GameModel) is a minimal constructor used for tests: it assigns the provided model and does not create a thread; callers must invoke startGame() and invoke handleCommand() synchronously.

    • GameController

      public GameController(GameModel model)
      Test-only constructor: receives a pre-built GameModel and does not own a game thread. start() and shutdown() are undefined for instances built this way.

    • GameController

      public GameController(List<PlayerEntry> players)
      Production constructor. Builds the GameModel from the players' views, kicks off the game (creates the phase handler) and prepares the game thread. The thread is started by start().

      public void start()

    • getQueue

      public BlockingQueue<ClientCommand> getQueue()
      The controller's internal queue, typed on ClientCommand. The LobbyManager uses this view to stack lifecycle command (PlayerDisconnectedCommand, PlayerReconnectedCommand, LeaveCommand during END_OF_GAME).

    • getGameCommandQueue

      public BlockingQueue<GameCommand> getGameCommandQueue()
      Same instance as getQueue(), exposed with the narrower BlockingQueue<GameCommand> type. This is the view given to PlayerEntry.setGameQueue(BlockingQueue): gli endpoint di rete metteranno esclusivamente GameCommand (sottotipi di ClientCommand), quindi il cast è sicuro per costruzione.

    • isGameOver

      public boolean isGameOver()

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Stop the game thread cleanly. Cancels any pending suspension timer, shuts down the scheduler, sets the running flag, interrupts the thread to unblock take(), and joins for up to 2 seconds. Only valid for instances built via GameController(List).

    • run

      public void run()
      Main game-thread loop. Blocks on queue and dispatches each dequeued command via cmd.accept(this). Unexpected handler exceptions are caught and logged so they never kill the thread. Exits cleanly when interrupted or when running is set to false by shutdown().
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • visit

      public void visit(GameCommand cmd)
      Entry point for in-game commands. Rejects the command with an error if the match is suspended (only one player connected). Silently drops the command if the current-turn player is disconnected. Otherwise delegates to handleCommand(GameCommand), routing any exception back to the sender as an error message.
      Specified by:
      visit in interface ClientCommandVisitor
      Parameters:
      cmd - the game command to dispatch
